unemployment.title: Unemployment
unemployment.summary: Georgia’s annual unemployment, employment and labour-force survey estimates, with published group comparisons.
unemployment.indicator.long_term_unemplo: Long-term unemployment rate (% of labour force)
unemployment.emptySelection: Select at least one series to display the data.
unemployment.emptyRange: The selected groups have no published observations in this period.
unemployment.compositionNote: Georgia · thousand persons · employed, unemployed and outside the labour force. These three groups make up the survey population; this national context is independent of the selected comparison groups.
unemployment.compositionAria: Georgia’s survey population aged 15+: stacked annual counts of employed, unemployed and people outside the labour force, in thousand persons
unemployment.ageNote: Ten-year age bands end in 2019; five-year bands begin in 2020. Historic groups remain separate and unavailable years are gaps.
unemployment.regionNote: Separate Imereti and Racha-Lechkhumi/Kvemo Svaneti begin in 2019; separate Samtskhe-Javakheti, Guria and Mtskheta-Mtianeti begin in 2017. Earlier combined regions remain distinct.
unemployment.educationNote: Education rates begin in 2020. Each rate uses its matching education/sex denominator. The reference is separately published; education counts and No education rates are unavailable.
unemployment.longTermNote: Long-term means 12 months or more. The rate is a percentage of the labour force; the share is a percentage of all unemployed people.
unemployment.sourceNote: Source: Geostat Labour Force Survey. Survey estimates, not census counts; displayed differences do not establish statistical significance.
unemployment.metaDescription: Explore Georgia’s official annual unemployment, employment and participation rates and counts by sex, age, settlement, region and education, with sources and Excel downloads.
